capability.summary: Inactive legacy alias that duplicates eslint_checker exactly and is retained only for compatibility metadata
capability.description: This misnamed legacy resource invokes the same `eslint -f json --no-config-lookup --config <cfg> <file>` command as eslint_checker and adds no capability. It is inactive and excluded from ordinary indexing; if invoked directly, it remains read-only and returns the same ESLint diagnostics without formatting or fixing code.
capability.problem_space: Compatibility metadata for an inactive, misnamed duplicate of eslint_checker; not a selectable linting or formatting capability and not a distinct implementation.

env_requirements: an ESLint config at SGAR_ESLINT_CONFIG or /opt/eslint.config.mjs
constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing file path accepted by the configured ESLint; output: JSON envelope containing parsed lint diagnostics and process metadata, never formatted source code.
accepted_inputs: an existing JavaScript or TypeScript source file supported by the selected ESLint configuration
constraint.output_shape: Completed lint (ESLint exit 0 or 1): {status: "success", tool: "eslint", target: string, exit_code: 0|1, result: array|object|null, stdout: string|null, stderr: string|null}; parsed native JSON diagnostics are in result and stdout becomes null. Other ESLint exits use the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagate the actual exit code. Missing file/executable/120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "eslint", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON. No success or failure shape contains a formatted_code key.
limitations: inactive legacy alias excluded from ordinary index construction and routing; use eslint_checker for the identical supported read-only lint behavior
duplicates eslint_checker flags, configuration selection, exit handling, timeout, and output shape exactly, so it provides no separate capability
the formatter name is misleading: direct invocation does not return formatted source, produce a diff, apply fixes, or modify files
retained only for compatibility metadata and must not be selected for ordinary lint, formatting, or fix requests

output_contract.description: JSON envelope of read-only ESLint diagnostics and exit metadata; despite the resource name, it contains no formatted code and causes no file writes.

negative_intents: run ordinary JavaScript or TypeScript lint checks
format, rewrite, or automatically fix JavaScript or TypeScript code
return formatted source code or a formatting diff
select a distinct capability instead of the supported eslint_checker duplicate

output_contract.description: JSON envelope of read-only ESLint diagnostics and exit metadata; despite the resource name, it contains no formatted code and causes no file writes.
